items.heading: Grapevine Daily Quote October 10
items.text: When I go to a meeting today, I no longer have the delusion that I am supporting a good cause. I need AA; AA did quite well without me during my ten years of self-exile. I go to AA meetings today to hear and see how God is working. When I share at a meeting, it is not to try and ‘help’ those poor wretches, it is because I need their help and guidance.
items.attribution: “Garden Hose Sobriety,” El Paso, Texas, October 2006, Voices of Long-Term Sobriety

items.heading: Cita Diaria con La Viña Octubre 10
items.text: Tengo una forma de vivir que llena todos los vacíos que alguna vez sentí.
items.attribution: “Prestarle atención a los sentimientos de los demás”. GRANTS, NUEVO MÉXICO, JULIO DE 1980
